map.ICCID 的结构是什么？: What is the structure of an ICCID?
map.按 ITU-T E.118，19–20 位数字：前 2 位主要行业标识 MII=: Per ITU-T E.118, 19–20 digits: MII 89 (telecom) + 1–3 digit country code (variable E.164) + issuer identifier (IIN) + individual account, with a Luhn check digit last. Country-code length varies (e.g. 1 for North America, 7 for Russia/Kazakhstan, 86 for China, 997 also for Kazakhstan), so the issuer segment shifts accordingly. MCC/MNC belong to IMSI, not ICCID.
map.校验通过代表 SIM 可用吗？: Does passing validation mean the SIM is usable?
map.不代表。ICCID 校验只验证卡号结构，是否激活、归属哪家运营商须运营商系统确认: No. The ICCID check only verifies the number structure; whether it is activated or which operator it belongs to must be confirmed by the operator's system.
map.为什么 19 位和 20 位都能通过？: Why do both 19- and 20-digit numbers pass?
map.ICCID 长度存在 19 位与 20 位两种实现，页面按 Luhn 校验末位，: ICCID length comes in 19- and 20-digit implementations; the page checks the last digit by Luhn, and passes as long as the length is within the allowed range.
